verdict.rationale: Brex documents an MCP server and AI-powered automation (invoice entry, GL coding), suggesting natural-language/agentic operation is possible, but community evidence directly disputes reliability — a Brex-published chatbot demo was called out for hallucinating/omitting expense data and being 'non-deterministic' for financial use cases, with commenters calling it 'sloppy engineering' and doubting production readiness.
